title: fix(lint)!: refuse a lookupFilters $record path to a structured field
body:
Fixes #34562

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — no page under `skills/` teaches a `$record` path to a structured field (the two `$record` samples in `skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md` read a date and a lookup hop to a select)

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：元数据作者在查找字段的过滤条件里，把"取当前记录的值"指向地址、JSON、重复组这类结构型字段时，校验会直接报错并给出改法；用户界面无变化。
- 为什么做：延续上一张"多值字段不能作单值比较"的修复，结构型字段同样没有单个可比较的值，以前校验放行、过滤看似生效实则不生效。
- 出错会怎样：最坏情况是作者原本能保存的这类写法现在被拒，需要改指向单值字段；撤回本改动即可恢复放行。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

`object-field-ref-unknown`, position `lookupFilters[N].value.$record`: a path whose HEAD (a plain path) or LEAF (behind one single-valued relationship hop) is a structured field is now refused, beside the multi-valued refusal and with the same hint (`singleValuedPrescription`, unchanged). The set is `STRUCTURED_JSON_TYPES` imported from `@objectstack/spec/data`, never re-listed. The verdict names it `a structured field`; the multi-valued verdict text is byte-identical.

A hop THROUGH a structured head (`s_address.city`) was already refused as the family's "not a relationship" miss and still is, once (pinned).

ADR-0087: a new semantic ledger entry `lookup-filter-record-path-structured-refused` (`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/19.lookup-filter-record-path-structured-refused.ts`, filed under protocol major 19 (`PROTOCOL_VERSION` 19.0.0, the 18.x line is released, so an `18.` file would be skipped on `--from 18`); `registry.ts` is generated and untracked), and the changeset carries `adr-0087: registered lookup-filter-record-path-structured-refused` plus a `@objectstack/spec` patch line.

Docs: `content/docs/data-modeling/relationships.mdx` listed only the unknown-path refusal; its sentence now also names a path whose first field, or leaf behind the hop, is multi-valued or structured.

Files: `packages/lint/src/validate-object-field-refs.ts`, `packages/lint/src/validate-object-field-refs.test.ts`, `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/19.lookup-filter-record-path-structured-refused.ts`, `content/docs/data-modeling/relationships.mdx`, `.changeset/34562-record-structural-lint.md`.

Read first (by risk):
1. `validate-object-field-refs.ts`, `multiValuedSegment` — the predicate now returns the noun (`what`); multi-valued is tested first so its findings keep their wording.
2. `validate-object-field-refs.ts`, the `singleValued` refusal block — the message interpolates `what`.
3. The new `describe('a path to a structured field (#34562)')` block in the test file.

## Tests

- New block beside the multi-valued block: `it.each` over every member of `STRUCTURED_JSON_TYPES` at the head and at the leaf (14 cases), each asserting the rule id, the full message and the full hint text; a coverage case that the five the card names are members; a CONTROL case (scalar head and leaf beside the structured fields) that stays clean; the hop-through case.
- Red without the fix: restoring the source file to the merge base turns exactly the 14 head/leaf cases red (`Tests 14 failed | 134 passed (148)`), control, coverage and hop-through stay green; restored.

## Acceptance notes

- S1 → follow-up #38141 (the `os lint --explain` text and the `$record` describes).
- The other `18.` ledger entries that landed after the protocol moved to 19 are out of this diff → #38142.
- `composite` and `record` (in the spec set, not in the card's five) are kept: `composite` values parse as `z.record(z.string(), z.unknown())` (`field-value.zod.ts`), `record` is a name-keyed map of sub-objects (`field.zod.ts`), and `filter-cross-field-comparison-class.ts` already classes the whole `STRUCTURED_JSON_TYPES` set as `list-or-object`, no comparison class. Neither has a scalar value.
- The hint is the multi-valued one verbatim ("a multi-valued field holds a list"), per the ruling; it reads slightly off for a structured field. Not reworded here.
- The verdict says `a structured field`, not `a structured TYPE field`: the type-named form put two fixture verdicts over the file's 200-character one-line ceiling.
- Measured first-party exposure, `git grep -n '\$record' origin/main -- examples packages/platform-objects packages/plugins skills` at 815e882b: 18 hits, zero `lookupFilters` `$record` paths to a structured field (the two lookup-filter hits are the skills samples above; the rest are flow `$record` variables in plugin-approvals).
- Docs read against the new refusal: `content/docs/data-modeling/fields.mdx` (its `$record` passage states no refusal list and teaches only `quote_date`) still holds; `content/docs/data-modeling/relationships.mdx` named only the unknown-path refusal and is corrected in this PR.
- CI at 9c2f41e6: the red `TypeScript Type Check` and `Test UI` rollups were their lanes `cancelled` (run 46096909426 and 46096909327 concluded `cancelled` when the next push superseded them), not failures; no re-run requested.

## Verification

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/validate-object-field-refs.test.ts -t "structured field"` — expect 17 passing tests.

<details><summary>Readings at head 9a9f0e64</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint typecheck && pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint test`: VERDICT command-exit 0, `Test Files 244 passed (244)`, `Tests 9873 passed (9873)`.
- `node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base origin/main`: exit 0, `[bang+clause-②-narrowing+metadata-protocol-narrowed] registered lookup-filter-record-path-structured-refused (new here)`.
- Registry regenerated by `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` (exit 0); `check:spec-changes`, `check:upgrade-guide`, `vitest run src/migrations` (207 passed) and the cli `migrate-meta-engine-guidance.test.ts` (3 passed) green. Probe on the built dist: `composeMigrationChain(18)` now includes `lookup-filter-record-path-structured-refused` (it did not under the `18.` name).
- Full dogfood battery, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` after building its closure: VERDICT command-exit 0, `Test Files 490 passed | 3 skipped (493)`, `Tests 4144 passed | 68 skipped (4212)`.
- Measured exposure: `git grep -n '\$record' origin/main -- examples packages/platform-objects packages/plugins skills` at 815e882b, 18 hits, zero `lookupFilters` `$record` paths to a structured field.

</details>
